title: Enforce an explicit outbound destination policy for remote torrent and search sources
description:
Fork research: parallel GPT-6 Astra source reviews, 2026-10-25. Current application baseline: 3ae404b.

## Purpose and evidence

Security prerequisite for easier ingestion and provider integrations. server/fetch.go bounds time and bytes but has no destination/redirect restrictions. Metadata may also introduce magnet sources, webseeds and tracker URLs; protecting only the initial /api/url request would leave alternate HTTP paths. The fork HTTPProxy option does not prove peer/DHT/DNS anonymity. Preserve deliberate LAN use through explicit operator policy rather than silently assuming every URL is public.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide a central operator-controlled policy for application outbound HTTP(S), including torrent URLs, provider configuration, search/detail/mirror requests, magnet HTTP sources, webseeds and HTTP trackers where supported by the torrent library; document separate P2P/UDP behavior precisely.
- Use a public-internet default and explicit narrowly scoped operator allowances for private/LAN destinations. Reject unsupported schemes, embedded credentials and forbidden loopback/link-local/private/metadata endpoints; validate resolved IPv4/IPv6 addresses at dial time to resist DNS rebinding.
- Revalidate each redirect and bound redirect count. Do not forward credentials across origins or expose sensitive URLs/headers in browser state or error logs. Do not claim a VPN or complete proxy boundary.
- Ensure upload, watch-folder and restored-session admission cannot bypass the policy through metadata URLs. Keep fixture-only loopback allowances explicit rather than weakening production defaults.
- Test direct and redirected forbidden hosts, mixed DNS answers, IPv6/mapped addresses, re-resolution, allowed LAN exceptions and each integrated fetch path without contacting real cloud metadata services.

## Sources

- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/server/api.go
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/engine/engine.go
- https://github.com/boypt/simple-torrent/blob/6f4942933b71106bae00b4f4c94438e3b315fca2/engine/engine.go#L112-L117
- https://github.com/makrron/simple-torrent/blob/12ac53d0e1aca83a2570c18389c07129c608bebd/search/client.go#L96

## Scope

Implement within the existing Go engine, typed API, generated frontend models and authenticated handler chain. Use isolated legal fixtures; never test against live downloads. This is a new backlog item, not a claim that the proposed behavior already exists.
